just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on G4 and dwells most on G in Daramad II. The line peaks at G4 (383.4 Hz) at 0:07.3. It closes on C4, not the tonic (D4 → G4 → G4 → Fs4 → G4 → C4).
